# Hover Card

> A preview of what a link leads to, shown beside it on hover and keyboard focus, with room for links and buttons of its own.

`<slab-hover-card>` · Overlays · built on `[popover]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/hover-card/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/hover-card.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-hover-card label="Ana Ruiz preview">
  <a href="/crew/ana" slot="anchor">Ana Ruiz</a>
  <div>
    <p>Forms lead. 12 pours this month.</p>
    <a href="/crew/ana/message">Message Ana</a>
  </div>
</slab-hover-card>
```

Use a Tooltip for a short description of a control, and a Hover Card to preview where a link goes. Touch users never see the card, and not every screenreader announces the anchor's `aria-details`, so anything in it should also be on the page the anchor links to.

Give it a `label` so the card is a named group, and Tab into it says where focus went.

## Keyboard

| Key    | What it does                                                                                                  |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab    | Focusing the anchor opens the card after `open-delay`. Tab again moves into the card. Leaving both closes it. |
| Escape | Closes the card. If focus is in the card, it goes back to the anchor.                                         |

## Elements

### `<slab-hover-card>`

Import `slab-elements/hover-card.js` to register it.

A hover card with no visual styles: rich content, shown in the top layer beside the element slotted as its `anchor`, for a sighted user to preview what's behind a link. Unlike a tooltip's, its content can hold links and buttons.

It opens when the anchor is hovered, or focused by keyboard, after `open-delay`. It closes when the pointer leaves, after `close-delay`, when focus leaves both the anchor and the card, and on Escape. The pointer can cross from the anchor onto the card without it closing, and focus moves into it with Tab, because its content follows the anchor in the focus order. Escape with focus in the card gives focus back to the anchor. A touch doesn't open it: a tap on a link follows the link.

A hover card is a preview, not the only way to what's in it, so whatever it holds should be reachable by following the anchor too. The anchor's `aria-details` points at the card's content, which tells a screenreader there's more about it without saying it opens anything. There's no `aria-expanded` or `aria-haspopup`: either would say a link expands or opens a menu when activating it navigates.

Give it a `label`, such as "Profile preview", and the card is a group named by it, so Tab into the card says where focus went. Without one, the card's content is read as it is.

It's placed beside its anchor with CSS anchor positioning, as Popover and Tooltip are, and flipped when it would leave the screen. `placement` picks the side and nothing else: the gap, the alignment, and every other visual choice are left to `::part(card)`. Where anchor positioning isn't supported, the card falls back to the browser's centering.

Style it through its `card` part and `:state(open)`.

#### Attributes

| Name          | Type                                     | Default    | Description                                                                        |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `close-delay` | `number`                                 | `300`      | How many milliseconds it waits after the pointer and focus leave before it closes. |
| `disabled`    | `boolean`                                | `false`    | The card doesn't open.                                                             |
| `label`       | `string`                                 |            | Makes the card a group named by it, announced when focus moves into it.            |
| `open-delay`  | `number`                                 | `700`      | How many milliseconds the pointer rests on the anchor before it opens.             |
| `open`        | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Whether it's open. Set it to open or close it.                                     |
| `placement`   | `'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | The side of its anchor it opens on, when there's room. It flips when there isn't.  |

#### Methods

| Signature                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hide(): void`                     | Closes it at once, without waiting for `close-delay`. Focus in the card goes back to the anchor, as it does on Escape.                                                             |
| `show(): void`                     | Opens it at once, without waiting for `open-delay`. It doesn't open while it's disabled.                                                                                           |
| `toggle(force?: boolean): boolean` | Opens it when it's closed, and closes it when it's open, as a native popover's `togglePopover()` does. `true` only opens it and `false` only closes it. Returns whether it's open. |

#### Events

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toggle`       | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does. |
| `beforetoggle` | `ToggleEvent` | Before it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` that doesn't bubble. Cancel it while it's opening to keep it closed.   |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description                                                                             |
| --------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `anchor`  | `Element` | The element the card is for, usually a link. It should be one that can be focused.      |
| (default) | `Element` | The card's content, which can hold links, buttons and anything else that can be focused |

#### CSS parts

| Name   | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| `card` | The card    |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |
| `:state(open)`     | While it's open.     |
